document_strings: Today - a limousine awaits you as a dignitary.
Jeff, I'm so sorry that Dad can't share the NACHUS we have regarding your achivements.
He would have been overjoyed reading the article about you in the New York magazine.
I was looking at family tapes.
We had many, many parties, anniversary parties etc, you enjoyed being there.
Today you avoid gatherings, parties - why?
Tonite is the deadline I must get this manuscript to Ghislaine.
If I know me, as soon as I mail it I will think of WHAT I should have said.
